rule: North Dakota's state races on the November 3, 2026 ballot, keyed by the race ids in ballot_local_2026.sqlite, by the same rule as the Congress pages (ballot/polls/polls_2026.json) and Minnesota's file (polls_mn_state_2026.json). Polls only from pollsters in AAPOR's Transparency Initiative (John, 2026-09-29): the latest from up to five of them, and our own average of the ten most recent, the arithmetic shown. Each poll's figures are checked against the pollster's own release; a list of polls (Wikipedia's, labelled as secondary) is used only to find them and to count the polls left out.
note: North Dakota elects no governor in 2026: the office was filled in 2024 and is next on the ballot in 2028. The statewide offices on this ballot are listed below.

left_out.note: Attorney General. No poll of this race by anyone was found: Wikipedia's page for it has no polling section (read 2026-10-02), and two news searches for North Dakota's 2026 statewide races found none. So no pollster in AAPOR's Transparency Initiative has published one, and none is left out.
